classification: STATIC FILE TREE CENSUS ONLY — not runtime-reachable, not UI surface total
coverageLimitations: A page file may only redirect or be a reusable component
A page may host multiple tabs, drawers, modal states and conditional role-dependent surfaces
Inline overlays are not identified by filename
Source tree does not establish reachable navigation, enabled modules or runtime states
A frontend route and vNext route are not automatically one-to-one
Backend controller enumeration does not prove every endpoint or persistence outcome
